closed_or_retained_mechanisms.result: DPP exact but rejected at 1.0183x / 0.0729 ms projected; raw rowvec8 gained 2.934% decode but failed complete prefill/quality ownership and was removed.
Exact local128 tile8 reached 1.1466x / 0.2958 ms projected and missed both frozen continuation gates; tile4, launch-width, half-sequential, dp4a/raw, and graph retries are closed.
Exact Q6 tile8 measured 0.9978x and was removed.
Q5 tile8 is already the retained gfx1151 default at 1.1715x leaf / about 1.0% eager; Q6 tile8/tile4 and complete mixed composites were rejected.
Exact shared-expert composite measured 0.899x and cross-queue selected/shared overlap regressed complete wall 2.058%.

cross_venue_context.qualification: Role order is stable against the independent high-power Framework Desktop lane. Absolute rates and durations are not old-to-new comparisons because zbook is a separate power-limited physical host.

decision.next_trigger: After SPECDEC2/MTP2 lands, rerun this exact profile only if route/kernel identity changes. Otherwise reopen AR-only work only for a new exact representation or dataflow with >=1.15x operation-complete leaf speedup or >=0.5 ms/token projected saving.
decision.reason: The clean current-main profile reproduces the same ownership order covered by the completed SH campaign. Every obvious non-overlapping MoE/GDN/LM-head mechanism is already retained or misses its frozen leaf/complete-wall gate. Repeating a near-miss is prohibited without a materially new operation/dataflow premise.

marker_timeline.interpretation: The interval residual is trace accounting/submission/dependency surface, not a recoverable-overhead claim. Prior exact per-layer MoE graph replay cut FFN launch count about 64% but regressed wall 0.84%.

analysis.purpose: Refresh current-main AR-only Qwen3.6 MoE ownership without touching SPECDEC2/MTP2 and decide whether one non-overlapping implementation is admitted.
